name: tinyassets-universe-server
description: TinyAssets — build, run, and steer custom AI agent workflows inside your command center. Also: custom AI builder, command center, agent workflow platform.
long_description: TinyAssets packages a multi-command-center control plane as a local MCP Bundle. Users design agent workflows as graphs of nodes and run autonomous daemons against them inside named command centers. Tiny is the acting intelligence users talk to; TinyAssets is the platform and distribution brand. Connect by natural phrases such as 'TinyAssets', 'Tiny', 'custom AI builder', 'command center', or 'my AI builder connector'.
